04. Black-box vs white-box testing

Black-box tests use observable requirements; white-box tests use code structure to select paths
and branches.

conditions සහ branches අනුව tests හදනවා.

Q: Can black-box tests be automated?
A: Yes. The distinction is about test design knowledge, not automation.
